plan.summary: Documents the new `retries` option in the requests guide. The page imports Docusaurus `Tabs` and `TabItem` and adds a Retries section. The section shows the TypeScript and Python call forms in tabs.
plan.riskRationale: Documentation-only change in one MDX file. No runtime code changes. The only risk is that the page fails to render if the Tabs imports are wrong.
plan.storyArc: The guide needs a Retries section. The tab components must be imported first. The section then uses them to show each language.

topics.title: Retries section with per-language tabs
topics.narrativeBrief: What does the guide now say about `retries`, and how does it show each language? Connect the Tabs imports in hunk-0 to their use in hunk-1. Verify that the import paths match other pages in the docs.
